summary.intent: Fix error E170 in the generated matrix release workflow template so that release plan/execute/build-python steps work in downstream repos, delivered as one branch and PR per fix with individual validation.
summary.outcome: Modified the matrix_workflow.tmpl to check out the release commit (detached HEAD) in its three checkouts, narrowed the test assertion on github.sha, updated the golden snapshot, added a changeset, committed on branch fix/matrix-template-detached-checkout, and created an entire trail for the bug. No push or PR is shown yet.

repo: Generated workflow templates live in crates/callisto-graph/src/templates/*.tmpl; the matrix workflow output is pinned by an insta golden snapshot in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init/snapshots/.
The init tests previously forbade `github.sha` anywhere in the matrix workflow to prevent SHA-based gating; it was narrowed to that intent so the checkouts can pin the release commit.
crates/callisto-cli/tests/release_artifact_owner_tests.rs also asserts on generated workflow content and needed an update alongside the init tests.
Changes require a .changeset/*.md file, and the repo uses cargo fmt and clippy with -D warnings across callisto-graph and callisto-cli.
Work is done in a git worktree (.claude/worktrees/macos-15-runners), with branches cut from origin/main using --no-track.
The root cause of E170 was that the generated matrix workflow checked out the branch, leaving HEAD attached.

code.finding: Three checkout steps were edited to pin the release commit and produce a detached HEAD, fixing E170 in release plan/execute/build-python.
The assertion banning github.sha in the matrix workflow was narrowed to its SHA-gating intent, and the three checkouts are now explicitly pinned.

workflow: Accept insta snapshot changes with INSTA_UPDATE=always, then check git diff --stat and remove stray *.snap.new files to confirm the snapshot changed only by the expected lines.
Run the narrow test target first (cargo test -p callisto-graph --lib commands::init) and then dependent crate tests, fmt, and clippy before committing.
Use absolute /usr/bin/git and pipe output through tail/head to keep tool output short.

friction: The changeset file was written twice, suggesting a first write needed correction or was rejected.
Several template and test files were read or edited multiple times, indicating iteration to get edits right.
The golden snapshot test failed initially and had to be regenerated, leaving .snap.new files that needed manual cleanup.
The final command chained commit and `entire trail create` with output filtered through grep, so the trail number/URL result is not visible and success is unconfirmed.
open_items: Other fixes from the 2026-11 sweeps remain: attestation flags, template pin drift, and other generated-output gaps, each planned as its own branch and PR.
The branch has not been pushed and no PR has been opened yet.
actionlint and zizmor availability was checked via `which`, but no workflow lint results are shown, so the generated workflow may not be linted.
The trail was created with a broad title covering multiple fixes; its output was not confirmed.
